items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Cab Calloway, I worked with him in San Francisco.

ctx.x: You got familiar with the black notes again.
Oh yeah. The band was good. They could read anything so. Cab Calloway, I worked with him in San Francisco.
Do you recall the first recording date in New York that you made?
